record.one_liner: Twilio SendGrid is a cloud email delivery platform for transactional and marketing email, via SMTP relay and a REST v3 Web API.
record.auth_notes: API key sent as 'Authorization: Bearer <API_KEY>'. Keys can be scoped with per-area permissions. The fetched auth page does not mention OAuth, so I found no documented OAuth flow for third-party apps.
record.access_notes: The fetched product page states a free trial of 100 emails/day for 60 days, then a paid plan. It covers the Web API and SMTP. I could not fetch the pricing page, so I could not confirm whether a permanent free tier exists, whether a credit card is needed, or the paid tier prices. Account vetting or sender verification may apply but I did not verify that.
record.blocker: Only a 60-day, 100/day trial was confirmed. Ongoing use needs a paid plan, and a permanent free tier is unconfirmed. There is no official SendGrid MCP server, and Twilio's official Alpha MCP covers Twilio's APIs, not confirmed for SendGrid. Rate limits are not verified.
